full_judgment: 2. Short facts necessary for disposal of this petition for leave to appeal are that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Other Suit No. 97 of 2001 in the 2nd Court of Joint District Judge, Cox's Bazaar impleading the respondents as defendants for declaration that the decision at clause "R" taken by defendant Nos. 1-3 in the 21st meeting of Shrimp Project Development and Management Committee was illegal, collusive and repugnant to the principle of natural justice stating, inter-alia, that they took lease of the suit land from the defendants vide Miscellaneous Case No.111-129 of 1984-85 for a period of one year and since then they are in possession thereof by paying rents to the Government. After expiry of the lease period the plaintiffs prayed for permanent Settlement of the suit land which is still pending for consideration, but meanwhile the defendants in the 21st Meeting dated 07.06.2001 of Shrimp Project Development and Management. Committee decided to lease out the suit land to the other persons and also to recover compensation from the plaintiffs for enjoying the suit land through illegal possession for the period 1990-93 giving cause of action to file the suit.
